answer: One defense ties each identity to a zero-knowledge proof of a unique government ID: the agent proves, without revealing it, that its ID maps to a fresh commitment plus a liveness check, stored as the only record. Each commitment mints one identity; duplicates are rejected. A vertex in the trust graph is one real person. Running a thousand Sybils needs a thousand distinct valid IDs, each carrying fraud and legal risk above any reward. Sybils, like water in karst, seek the cheapest route, but every route here costs a real identity, while the velvet glove of privacy stays on.
